_comment: FC-1 INC-0 byte-identity gate, arm B (ON, shadow).  Identical to _fc1_byteid_off.json
except that the fast-clock tier is ARMED in shadow mode.
Shadow runs the tick body on FULL epochs (epoch_decimation_n stays 1, so there are no
decimated-out epochs), immediately before the full pipeline, and discards the result.
Both FC-1 hooks are therefore exercised on every epoch of this run: the shadow tick
GATE: products.txt and every estimation CSV must be byte-identical to arm A.  The only
permitted differences are logs/network_fast_clock.csv (which arm A does not open at
all), the FC-1 lines in main_log.log, and the fast_clock_* keys in the run manifest.
A difference anywhere else means the tick is not isolated from the full pipeline,
which is the one property that makes this card safe to land incrementally.
